experimental_method: Dew points of water in CO2 and in a CO2+2.5% N2+5.8% O2 mixture observed visually in a glass microfluidic channel: single-phase wet sample prepared at 75 C by injecting a known water volume into a CO2 cylinder, chip held isothermal while pressure is lowered until droplets appear, then pressure tuned until droplet size is constant (P = P_dew).
uncertainties_stated: Dead volume of preparation system accurate to 0.4%; pressure drop across chip at fill about 0.04 MPa; condensed-water effect on P_dew estimated up to 0.86 MPa underestimate at y=0.00489, 13.2 MPa, 40 C (SI); std deviation of P_dew from theory 4.84% for the pure CO2-water validation. Temperature and pressure transducer uncertainties not tabulated in the main text.
quality_remarks: Paper text says pure-CO2 data are in Table SI 1 (Supporting Information, not available); main-text Table 1 gives prepared water contents with dew pressures. Y_H2O set by pump pressure so concentration is computed afterwards from injected water volume and final P,T. Compared with theory for pure CO2 only. Table headers print T as C with no scale stated. Rows with N/A have no measured dew point.
